sources.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) - 1m
facts: metres referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn
composite uses newest/best-resolution survey where repeats exist
limits: location-specific survey lineage required before freshness claim
bare-earth DTM only; DSM cannot substitute

sources.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
facts: 25 cm, 50 cm, 1 m and 2 m resolutions depending on survey
ODN heights aligned to OS Grid
survey-specific transformation/geoid lineage available through metadata catalogue
limits: survey archive is lineage evidence until exact target intersection is returned
quarterly metadata cadence does not prove a target has newer coverage

sources.name: LIDAR Ground Truth Surveys
facts: independent ground-truth points approximately +/-3 cm RMSE
LIDAR surveys must be below +/-15 cm RMSE
ground truth includes survey date, method, transformation and geoidal models
limits: ground-truth point accuracy is not parcel elevation accuracy
must not assign +/-3 cm to DTM parcel result

sources.name: Survey Data Catalogue vertical accuracy FAQ
facts: absolute height error specification less than +/-15 cm RMSE
expected relative random height error no more than +/-5 cm
limits: specification-level accuracy must not replace target-specific uncertainty analysis

sources.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Extents FeatureServer
facts: query formats JSON, geoJSON and PBF
fields include sd_flown, ed_flown, pt_spacing, transform, geoid, year, latest and polygon_id
limits: service/schema availability is not an exact target query result

sources.name: INSPIRE Index Polygons current dataset
facts: polygons represent position and indicative extent
limits: indicative extent is not exact legal boundary

sources.name: INSPIRE July 2026 download
facts: current page states dataset published 5 July 2026
limits: publication freshness does not change indicative-boundary semantics

sources.name: INSPIRE GML technical guidance
facts: BNG-to-WGS84 reprojection may shift features up to 15 m
limits: reprojected geometry cannot be used as exact cadastral-match basis

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 July 2026 / grid specification
limits: secondary cross-check only for parcel-scale DTM work
50 m grid cannot replace EA 1 m polygon sampling
